newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products lower, except gasoline.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products lower, except gasoline.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly lower on Tuesday, except gasoline, traders said.
Premium unleaded gasoline rose $1.00 as U.K. stock-building continued. Naphtha prices were slightly lower with traders looking for arbitrage chances to North America.
Diesel cargoes arriving from the United States and Algeria put severe pressure on European diesel premiums on Tuesday, but heating oil was steady,
High sulphur cracked barges were down $2 at $110 fob pressured by lack of buying and good supplies.
